note: Corps of Engineers campground on Card Creek just above where it enters Elk City Lake, 5 miles west of Independence off US-160 (paved to the park). One gravel row along the creek: 15 electric sites (9 with water too) and 4 without; the sites on the creek side of the road (about 8-14) sit on open grass above the bank. Boat ramp; the Elk River Hiking Trail is adjacent. Site 14 closed for maintenance until further notice (recreation.gov notice, read 2026-11-06). --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + live catalog: 19 back-in sites (15 at 30 A, 9 with water; 4 non-electric), 23-89 ft (max 99 -> 89), rates $12/$16/$18 2026-2028, showers, vault toilet, dump; open year round (now stated); 14-night max. Riverfront stands (channel ~50 m, open bank at sites 8-14). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverfront' stands: imagery (160 m frame) shows the gravel row on the east bank of the Card Creek channel, which is ~45-60 m wide at the sites (over the ~30 m creek line, so riverfront rather than creekside; rec.gov calls it 'along Card Creek which flows into Elk City Lake'). Sites 8, 10-14 have their pads on the creek side of the camp road with open grass and a sparse line of bank trees, ~20-35 m to the water and no road or day use between. Sites 1-7 and 16-20 are on the inland side or at the north end. It is the creek arm, not the open lake (the main lake is out of the 1.4 km frame).
MAX RIG 99 -> 89: no catalog site lists 99; the longest Max Vehicle Length is 89 (site 20). Site 8 is posted at 23 ft and site 4 at 25 ft, tight for EKKO; the rest are 32 ft+.
SITE COUNT 19 kept: rec.gov's description says '15 electric campsites and 5 primitive', the catalog has 15 + 4 (and a group shelter).
SEASON newly written year_round from the facility description ('Camping is available year round'); rates run all year too.
PARTIAL CLOSURE: rec.gov notice 'Campsite 14 is closed for maintenance until further notice' - one site only, put in the note, no status.
PIN 37.25672,-95.850012 is ~10 m from the live catalog centroid (37.25664,-95.85002); fine. Phone 620-336-2741 = rec.gov facility_phone; website (rec.gov page) fine. USACE-operated, not a concession.
AMPERAGE checked live: 30 A on all 15 electric sites (no 50 A in live or cached catalog). minHolidayWeekendStay is 0/soft = no rule.
